bias.zh: 偏空 · 再度失守 $320，自 $295 反弹

read.en: Teradyne fell 3.2% on Oct 28 to $313.24, trading between $295.00 and $317.00 on 1.7 times average volume. It is just above the falling 5-day ($312.7) and below the falling 10-day ($324.9), 30-day ($373.7) and 100-day ($376.6) averages and the rising 200-day ($349.0). MACD has been below its signal since Oct 12, below zero, histogram narrowing; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 8 ($340.07), and RSI is 36.
read.zh: 泰瑞达 10月28日下跌 3.2%，收于 $313.24，盘中区间 $295.00–317.00，成交量为均量的 1.7 倍。股价略高于下行的 5 日均线（$312.7），低于下行的 10 日（$324.9）、30 日（$373.7）和 100 日均线（$376.6）以及上行的 200 日均线（$349.0）。MACD 自 10月12日起位于信号线及零轴下方，柱状图收窄；抛物线 SAR 自 10月8日起看空（$340.07），RSI 为 36。

read.en: The close lost the $319.5–320 support (Oct 26 high), now resistance; a dip to $295, under the $304–306 lows and the $296.8 Jul 17 low, recovered above the $309.4 May 19 low. Resistance is $317–320, then $324.9–328.8 (10-day, Oct 27 high) and $340.1 (SAR). Support is $309.4, then $304.3–306.4 and $295–296.8. A close above $320 would target $325–329; below $309, $305.

r.zh: 抛物线 SAR；其上为 200日均线 $349.0
